topic.title: Electric Vehicle Charging / Permitted Development / Street Works
topic.source_contract: site and parking context, permitted-development class or planning route, prior approval where applicable, building-regulation scope, electrical capacity, distribution connection, equipment specification, accessibility, highway authority approval, street works permit, section 115E interface, installation, testing, commissioning, operation and utilisation evidence

scope_guards: A grant-eligible chargepoint is not a permitted installation.
Permitted development is not assumed without class and limitation checks.
A street works permit is not planning permission.
A grid quotation is not a completed connection.
Installed equipment is not commissioned operation.
Commissioning is not evidence of public availability.
A planned cross-pavement solution is not an approved highway installation.
No score or promotion is written without exact permission route, connection, commissioning and operation evidence.
